segments.text:
ALmightie God, geue vs grace, that we maye caſte away the workes of darkenes, & put vpon vs the armour of light, now in the time of this mortal life,
(in the which thy ſonne Ieſus Chriſte came to viſite vs in great humilitie:) that in the laſt daye, when he ſhal come again in his glorious maieſtie, to iudge bothe the quicke and the dead: we maye ryſe to the lyfe immortall, through him, who liueth and reigneth with thee and the holy ghoſt, now and euer. Amen.
